milestones.topic: PMAPFIX internal-boot panic resolution and R32-ELSQWAIT / R32-PCFIX2 8/8 Geekbench 6 Metal breakthrough
milestones.summary: Decoded AAPL,PanicInfo0000..0003 (d1c3e3018b832b524cd3a7df730de77428f372222540c8a42e6d29ec11b628e6) identified pmap_recycle_page at 0x101310000; reserving 0x101000000..0x101400000 (4 MiB) under UEFI -> ReservedMemory with debug=0x100000 eliminated pmap_recycle_page panics across all 28 subsequent trials. Unconditional elsqWait, GEN8_ROW_CHICKEN2 (0xe4f4=0xc100c100), CS_CHICKEN1 (0x2580=0x00020002), and hpSanitizeComputeEncoder (R32-PCFIX2, NootedGreen SHA-256 f52f0d44d304e55e95b9875adb2c198b0950578b0ce4cc07191cc534962b1a54) completed all 8 Geekbench 6.5.0 Metal workloads (25,088 encoders) with 0 GPU hangs and 0 GPURestart, deployed to internal NVMe /boot/EFI/OC.
milestones.limitation: Multi-run back-to-back endurance testing was subsequently completed in R32-PCFIX3..R32-PCFIX27.

milestones.topic: 100% Three-Stage GPU Stability & Endurance Pass (R32-PCFIX27-PMAPFIX, 705,024 compute encoders, 0 hangs) & Internal NVMe /boot/EFI/OC Deployment
milestones.summary: Implemented lossless Single-Port RCS Execlist scheduling (PCFIX6, 0 Port1 submissions, 0 LITE_RESTORE, 0 0x40002098 freezes, 100% clean XeNG GPUREC: reset RCS ret=1 recovery); verified 5/5 DualSubslices (80 EU) 0xffffffff idle completion in PCFIX22..PCFIX26; persisted CS_DBG1=00000010 and CHKN3=00002000 across context switches via 64-bit shifted _WA_TABLE bits 0xf5f|=0x80 and 0xf68|=0x01 in PCFIX25/PCFIX26; and in R32-PCFIX27 (NootedGreen SHA-256 56c2d0758770803190b70b897e06b1ed5ab5318df97fef0c1fc4c07a2de2ffd9, UUID 4C4C44D2-5555-3144-A1F9-D192CDF39360), preserved ResetPreambleCmds Packet 1 (dw[+1]=0x001010a0U before PIPELINE_SELECT=GPGPU) while changing Packet 3 (dw[+19] after MEDIA_STATE_FLUSH in GPGPU mode) to 0x001000a0U on the clean PCFIX20 baseline, passing 100% of all three stages of the Real-Machine GPU Stability & Endurance Test Plan (705,024 encoders, 0 GPU hangs, 0 GPURestart, 0 kernel panics).
milestones.limitation: Subsequent peripheral, S0ix, and video blit adaptations continued in 2026-11-07..2026-11-11.

milestones.summary: Deployed Realtek ALC285 internal speakers + headphone jack auto-switching (SimpleHDA 1.0.1 + AppleALC 1.9.8 layout-id 71 + hp-alc285-ampinit.sh), enrolled RidgeKey 1.0.0 (ridgekeyd + pam_ridgekey.so + RidgeKey.app + RidgeKeyAgent.app) on the built-in Synaptics 06cb:00f0 Match-on-Chip USB fingerprint sensor for sudo/admin/Lock Screen authentication, implemented R32-PCFIX31 AppleBacklightDisplay + PCH SBLC_PWM_CTL2 (0xc8254) duty-cycle synchronization with libhp_cb_shim.dylib Control Center slider, and enabled full top-row Fn+F1..Fn+F11 hotkeys via VoodooPS2Controller + hp-bridge.

milestones.summary: Implemented TGLDmic.kext v0.5.0 (1,199,424 B, SHA-256 b0d0715d5a795958a2d557e6362839ce2b4947a899f18094c05eb48ac067a5aa + TGLDmic.driver CoreAudio HAL driving Tiger Lake Intel cAVS 2.5 DSP sof-tgl.ri 48 kHz 4-ch internal quad-DMIC), eliminated 420v NV12 video green/corruption via R32-PCFIX35 HP-BLITALIGN + xe-h264sw-fixd, and verified 51m 37s Modern Standby S0ix Deep Idle sleep/wake via S0ixStandby.kext v0.4.4 + SSDT-DEEPIDLE + R32-PCFIX32..PCFIX36 (540,656 B, SHA-256 85eac4f7247f8de0bb84f3be9c83ec3fe664a6c1e8043a18b078b25d3320b339, UUID 4C4C446E-5555-3144-A18C-AEFB17BBF3B7).
